title: Beijing bolsters South China Sea push with new island runway: Analysts
paragraphs: Beijing bolsters South China Sea push with new island runway: Analysts

The nearly 3km runway on Antelope Reef in the Paracel Islands could significantly strengthen China's military footprint in the strategic waterway, according to experts and satellite images seen by AFP.

TOKYO: China is building a runway on another island in the disputed South China Sea that could significantly strengthen its military footprint in the strategic waterway, according to experts and satellite images seen by AFP.
